text: End of course test, track one. Good afternoon everyone and welcome to Transit. Hello sports scientists, my name is Jez Barton and today I'm going to talk to you about being a personal trainer. Let me tell you a bit about myself. After studying sports science at university, I worked on cruise ships for four years as a sports trainer. Then I got married and wanted to stop travelling, so I got a job with a gym in Dubai. For the last five years I have had my own personal training business. I'm sure you understand what personal training is, but I'll start by giving you more information about the business. Last year the personal training industry was worth 13.1 billion dollars in the USA and 768 million pounds in the UK. Our industry is growing by 6.1% each year. These days more people understand how important exercise is, so it's not a luxury to have a personal trainer anymore. There are about 340,000 personal trainers in the US and there will be another 47,500 over the next 10 years. So what does a personal trainer do and how much do we earn? The average salary of a personal trainer in the US is $46,000 per year or around $22 an hour. But if you work for yourself, you can charge much more. In Dubai the best trainers can earn over $100,000 a year because there are lots of rich people in the city. But this takes time. You need to work on your own strengths and weaknesses first and develop your skills. If you want to work with champion athletes, this isn't a job for you. Only a few of my customers play in sports teams or compete in events. Most of them are ordinary people. My job is to support them and help them to achieve their personal fitness goals. I get up early, usually at 4.30am, since some of my clients come to me before work. Sometimes I work for 6 hours with only a 10 minute break. I don't spend time with my children as much as I would like because I have customers who want to train after work too. But I love my job because it makes a difference to people's lives. Around 80% of personal trainers leave their jobs after the first year. But those who stay, stay for the same reason. It's a great feeling when you see positive changes in a person's life thanks to your personal training program.
